"""
Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0
"""

from collections import deque
from test.unit.rules import BaseRuleTestCase
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator, ValidationError
from cfnlint.rules.resources.ResourceType import ResourceType


class TestTypeTrueAndFalse(BaseRuleTestCase):
    """Test AWS Types with conditional scenarios yielding both True and False"""

    def setUp(self):
        """Setup"""
        super(TestTypeTrueAndFalse, self).setUp()
        self.rule = ResourceType()

    @patch("cfnlint.template.Template", autospec=True)
    def test_types_with_conditions_true_and_false(self, cfn):
        cfn = Mock()
        cfn.conditions = Mock()
        # Simulate a condition that could be True or False in the region
        cfn.conditions.build_scenerios_on_region.return_value = [True, False]
        validator = CfnTemplateValidator({}).evolve(cfn=cfn)
        errors = list(
            self.rule.validate(
                validator,
                "cfnResources",
                {"Type": "Foo::Bar::Type", "Condition": "IsUsEast1"},
                {},
            )
        )

        self.assertListEqual(
            errors,
            [
                ValidationError(
                    "Resource type 'Foo::Bar::Type' does not exist in 'us-east-1'",
                    path=deque(["Type"]),
                    schema_path=deque([]),
                    rule=ResourceType(),
                ),
            ],
            errors,
        )

text: Plan: - Reproduce the bug with a focused unit test that models a condition excluding certain regions. - Locate and adjust the rule logic to honor conditions when checking resource type availability. - Verify with unit tests, including cases where the condition can be both True and False, ensuring validation is only skipped when the condition cannot be True. What I changed: - Updated src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ResourceType.py to correctly honor conditions per region when validating resource type availability. - Previous behavior: skipped validation whenever False appeared in the scenarios returned by conditions.build_scenerios_on_region(condition, region). - New behavior: build the scenario set and skip validation only if the condition cannot be True in that region (i.e., True is not present). - Diff: - Old: - if False in validator.cfn.conditions.build_scenerios_on_region(resource_condition, region): continue - New: - scenarios = set(validator.cfn.conditions.build_scenerios_on_region(resource_condition, region)) - if True not in scenarios: continue Tests added and run: - Created a new test at test/unit/rules/resources/test_type_true_and_false.py to cover the case where build_scenerios_on_region returns [True, False]. This verifies that a ValidationError is emitted because the condition could be True in that region, so type availability must be checked. - Ran existing tests in test/unit/rules/resources/test_type.py and the new test. Result: 4 passed. Why this fixes your issue: - Your template applies a Condition that excludes cn-north-1 for GlobalAccelerator resources. When linting with -r cn-north-1, build_scenerios_on_region will yield scenarios indicating the condition cannot be True in that region. - With the corrected logic, ResourceType will skip availability validation for that resource in cn-north-1 because True is not present in the scenarios for that region. Therefore, E3006 will no longer be raised for that resource in excluded regions. - Conversely, if a condition allows creation in a region (True present), the rule will validate availability and raise E3006 appropriately. Notes: - The conditions API function is named build_scenerios_on_region (misspelling intentional); the fix uses this exact name. - I did not commit changes, per your request.
